mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, workflow_runtime_generation, record_type, record_id, date_field, source_date, scheduled_local_date, due_at, state, workflow_run_id, queued_at, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_date_enrollment (workspace_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, workflow_runtime_generation, record_type, record_id, date_field, source_date, scheduled_local_date, due_at, state, resolved_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowId}, #{workflowVersionId}, #{workflowRuntimeGeneration}, #{recordType}, #{recordId}, #{dateField}, #{sourceDate}, #{scheduledLocalDate}, #{dueAt}, #{state}, #{resolvedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(e.state = 'planned'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS planned_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(e.state = 'queued'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS queued_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(e.state = 'missed'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS missed_count, MIN(CASE WHEN e.state = 'planned' THEN e.due_at END) AS next_due_at, ( SELECT MAX(o.completed_at) FROM workflow_trigger_outbox o WHERE o.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND o.workflow_id = w.id AND o.workflow_runtime_generation = w.runtime_generation AND o.trigger_type = 'date_reconcile' AND o.status = 'completed' ) AS last_reconciled_at FROM workflow w JOIN workflow_version v ON v.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND v.workflow_id = w.id AND v.id = w.active_version_id AND v.trigger_type = 'date' LEFT JOIN workflow_date_enrollment e ON e.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND e.workflow_id = w.id AND e.workflow_runtime_generation = w.runtime_generation WHERE w.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.id = #{workflowId} GROUP BY w.workspace_id, w.id, w.runtime_generation
SELECT FROM workflow_date_enrollment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_date_enrollment SET workflow_version_id = #{workflowVersionId}, workflow_runtime_generation = #{workflowRuntimeGeneration}, scheduled_local_date = #{scheduledLocalDate}, due_at = #{dueAt}, state = 'planned', queued_at = NULL, resolved_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND state = 'superseded' AND queued_at IS NULL AND workflow_run_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM workflow_date_enrollment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND state = 'planned' AND due_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY due_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
